DisplayName.value: Chaotic's Stash - Put It Back Where It Lives

Description.value: Press one key and every stack you are carrying that a nearby container ALREADY holds goes straight into that container. Tops up matching stacks first, and only ever starts a new stack in a chest that already has the item, so nothing lands somewhere it does not belong. Works on every container in range at once with no window open - not a quick stack button. Skips locked slots, skips chests someone else locked or has open, skips un-looted world crates. Key, radius, toolbelt, quality items and an ignore list are all configurable. Needs installing on the client, and EAC off.
